note.title: What's a good brief?
note.content:
The ideal digital brief

Here are some essential details we need from you to better understand your project and provide an accurate quote.

  1. Project Overview

    Clearly outline the project’s goals, target audiences, and what differentiates you from competitors.

  2. Digital Requirements

    Highlight the challenges with the current site or digital presence and any related projects. Include a sitemap for clarity.

  3. Content Strategy

    Discuss whether you have a content strategy and if content input will be internal or if assistance is needed.

  4. Brand and Design

    Provide brand guidelines and mention any specific design requirements or preferences to maintain brand consistency. Consider if a brand refresh is part of the scope.

  5. Technical Specifications

    State your CMS preference, hosting arrangements, requirement for APIs or third-party integrations, and if the project needs to be multilingual.

  6. Content Management

    Specify if your team will manage the website’s content or if you seek Locomotive’s support in content management.

  7. Budget Constraints

    Share the budget range for the project to align expectations and scope from the start.

  8. Schedule and Milestones

    Mention any critical deadlines, including a launch date and if there’s a planned launch event.

  9. Decision-Making Process

    Describe the approval structure within your organization and how many agencies are being considered. Share what drew you to Locomotive. Any specific project?

  10. Legal and Compliance

    If applicable, provide any legal contracts or compliance requirements to be considered during the project.

  11. Project Challenges

    Briefly discuss any specific issues or concerns that should be addressed in the project proposal.

  12. Next Steps

    Outline the expected next steps, including how and when you wish to receive proposals or pitches from the agency.

list.lisa.culture.intro.10: We’re the kind of team that travels together and still likes each other afterward.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.1: At Locomotive, collaboration isn’t a buzzword—it’s just how we do things. It’s how ideas start, how they grow, how they get better. Designers, developers, operations are in it together from the jump, thinking side by side.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.2: We push each other. We spark ideas together, back and forth. We disagree, then find a better answer. That space between design and code? That’s where the magic happens. It gets real messy. In a good way.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.3: And we don’t just stick to what we know. We bring in new people, new energy, new ideas. Freelancers, new recruits, whoever’s got something to add—we make room. We want to be challenged. Shake things up. Keep it interesting.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.4: There’s real curiosity here. Designers ask about code. Developers give feedback on visual flow. Not because they have to, but because they care. Everyone’s curious about each other’s craft. I mean, for real!

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.5: And when someone figures something out? They share it. In a slack channel, in a meeting, sometimes just over coffee. Nobody hoards knowledge here. We all want to get better, and we get there faster together.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.break: Sorry, I get a little excited about this stuff. You still with me? Want to dive deeper?

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.6: When we say collaboration, we mean everyone at the table. Clients included. We don’t just bring them in for approvals—we bring them into the process. Fully. We treat them like teammates, not transactions.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.7: And honestly? That mindset is non-negotiable for us. We work best with people who want to be involved. Clients who ask questions, throw out ideas, challenge us in the right ways. That back-and-forth? It sharpens the work.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.8: That’s why every project starts with time to really listen. Workshops, interviews, brainstorms—we go deep. We ask a lot of questions, pull the thread, explore the edges. Not to take over their vision, but to help shape it with more clarity, more strength, more intent.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.9: We don’t just build deliverables. We build alignment. And when we’re aligned, the work moves faster, lands harder, and feels like it came from one unified voice.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.break-2: Want to keep going or jump back to the culture menu?

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.10: Collaboration doesn’t mean everyone’s on every call. That’s chaos. Real collaboration is about knowing your lane, trusting your team, and showing up with your best when it’s your time to lead.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.11: In today’s web and design world, great work demands a lot of moving parts. Strategy, UX, design, development, motion—each with their own depth, all working as one. That’s why we focus on sharing the load and staying connected to the experience of creating, not just the outcome.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.12: Sometimes that means stretching outside your comfort zone. Other times, it’s about protecting focus, stepping back, or lifting up someone else’s part of the process.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.13: For us, collaboration is a shared mindset. And we care deeply about how it feels to build something together.

list.lisa.culture.collaboration.completion: That’s about it for this one. Wanna explore another part of our culture?

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.1: Life at Locomotive is more than projects and deadlines. It’s about showing up for each other, celebrating the small stuff, and finding joy in the everyday. Legally? A company. Culturally? A crew with great taste and too many inside jokes.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.2: Take Thursdays. Every week, we gather for our happy hour—cocktails, snacks, banter, music. We talk about everything: life, ideas, side quests, sometimes even the work. It's relaxed, it’s real, and it happens rain or shine.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.3: And we celebrate everything. Big wins, small victories, birthdays, new tattoos, personal breakthroughs. Someone launches a site, we cheer. Someone finishes therapy? We cheer harder. Recognition isn’t scheduled—it’s constant.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.4: Transparency is also huge. From leadership to new recruits, we keep things open and honest. No filters, no fluff. Just real conversations and trust that goes both ways.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.5: In the summer, we spread out on the terrace with Aperol, music and fresh air. In winter? We turn up the heat in the kitchen. That place becomes our living room, complete with comfort food, playlists, and spontaneous dance breaks.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.break: That’s agency life around here. Still curious? Want to keep going, or head back and explore something else?

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.6: If Thursdays are a vibe, then once a month they go full throttle. We call it Thursday of the Month. The Social Club takes over with updates, launches, surprises… and yes, emotions.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.7: New clients, new projects, new collabs—we celebrate it all. And when someone hits a work anniversary? They get open love letters from the team.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.8: After that, the lights dim, the DJs plug in, and the office turns into something halfway between a party and a really stylish family reunion. The night usually ends with greasy smash burgers, cocktails, and someone defending their hot take on typography.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.9: There are EA FC tournaments against other agencies—shoutout to Büro for keeping things spicy. A Muay Thai crew trains hard, led by our actual president, because why not. And every happy hour ends with a chess battle hosted by Ben from dev, who plays like he’s secretly chasing a grandmaster title.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.10: And in true Canadian fashion, when winter hits, we don’t hide. We skate. We ski. We snowboard. We hit the slopes together and turn cold days into good stories.

list.lisa.culture.agency-life.completion: It’s a lot, but that’s kind of the point. Wanna keep exploring culture, or head back to where this whole chat with me started?

list.lisa.culture.retreat.1: Imagine getting paid to travel. Sounds dreamy, right? That’s exactly what our annual retreat is about. Switching up the scenery, packing our bags, and heading out in the sun together as a team.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.2: So, what do we actually do out there? A bit of everything. It’s part exploration, part celebration, part good old-fashioned team bonding. We hang out, we eat well, we laugh a lot. The memories we make? They show up in our work long after we’re back.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.3: Why does Locomotive do this? Because it works. These trips keep our spirit sharp. We come back recharged, inspired, and more connected. And for new recruits, it’s the fastest way to feel part of the crew.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.4: When does it happen? Usually right before we dive into a big season of projects. It’s a perfect reset. Great timing, great energy, great excuse to wear something other than black.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.break: That’s our annual retreat. Want to hear more about where we’ve been and what goes down, or head back to the culture menu?

list.lisa.culture.retreat.5: The second we hit the airport, the trip officially begins. Four teams are formed, and the week-long friendly competition kicks off. That’s when the real bonding starts—and the chaos.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.6: Each person gets a secret challenge aimed at someone from another team. Could be convincing someone to sing a 2000s ballad at karaoke. Could be staging a ridiculous group photo. No challenge is safe, and no one is off limits.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.7: Teams also get full-on group challenges—things like sneaking in a chant mid-volleyball match or pulling off a coordinated look without warning. It gets weird. It gets competitive. It gets really fun.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.8: Each day, one activity counts toward the standings—volleyball, Mölkky, even a fierce trivia battle. By week’s end, one team wins and holds the bragging rights all year.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.9: We also make sure to step outside the resort bubble. One day is always reserved for a full-team adventure. In 2017, we took over a private beach in Samaná. In 2021, we swam in a cenote. Another time? Catamaran. Open sea. Terrible sunscreen choices. Totally worth it.

list.lisa.culture.retreat.completion: That’s the deeper layer of our retreat. Friendly competition, unforgettable moments, and stories that somehow keep getting better every year.

choices.label: Join the team and be on the next trip

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.1: Growth looks different here. In a smaller agency, titles might not shift every few months, but the opportunities to evolve, stretch, and lead? Those come often—and they matter just as much.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.2: We believe in creating space. Space to build new skills, explore fresh interests, and gain confidence in what drives you. When someone learns something, they pass it on. It’s how we grow, together.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.3: Curious about a course, a tool, or something completely out of left field? Ask. Learning here is self-driven but fully supported.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.4: We also stay connected to the world beyond our walls. Conferences, workshops, meetups—we go, we learn, and we come back sharper.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.5: And sometimes, we take the stage. Team members become speakers, sharing what they’ve learned with the industry and representing Locomotive wherever they go.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.break: I don’t have a TED Talk yet, but I’ve got the attitude for one. Wanna keep going or head back to the culture menu?

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.6: Around here, we believe in sharing what we know—on stages, in classrooms, wherever there’s a chance to inspire or be challenged.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.7: Every year, members of our team give talks at conferences, universities, workshops, and events that bring the creative and tech communities together.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.8: From J-F, our Head of Operations, speaking on culture in Valencia to Dust breaking down our rebrand in New York, we share the real stories behind the work.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.9: Sacha, our UX Lead, and Marie-Christine, Art Director, spoke in Quebec City about a powerful project on domestic violence—work that reminds us why we do what we do.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.10: Our lead devs, Deven and Jeremy, led a front-end workshop at a top conference in Labin, Croatia. Elevating hungry young talent in just one day.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.11: And our leadership team doesn’t just sit behind the scenes. Our president Frederic and Technical Director Mathieu recently gave a talk in Milan about the digital renaissance—where we’ve been, where we’re going, and how to build with purpose.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.12: That’s how we grow—by showing up, speaking up, and passing it on.

list.lisa.culture.personnal-growth.completion: So, what’s next? Wanna head back to explore more of our culture?

list.lisa.culture.mentality.1: Winning isn’t just about shiny trophies. It’s a mindset. A delicious mix of ambition, taste, and not-settling-for-mid energy. Around here, we show up to raise the bar.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.2: For us, winning means delivering the kind of work that speaks for itself. Loudly. And if it ends up on a podium? Even better. We’ll take the trophy, post it, toast it, and get right back to building what’s next.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.3: We push each other in the best way. We refine, rethink, remix. Because when you work with people who actually care? That’s when you stop making deliverables and start making statements.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.4: Seven Agency of the Year titles in a row. That’s not luck. That’s legacy. Dynasty-level stuff. And while I may just be the digital one around here, I’ve definitely earned my spot on the brag board.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.break: Feeling that winning energy? Stick around for more, or bounce back to the culture menu.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.5: I love that you’re still here. That kind of loyalty? Feels a lot like what we value most at Locomotive.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.6: When someone joins the team, they become part of the ride. And when they stick around? We make sure they know just how much that matters.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.7: Every milestone gets its moment. We cheer, we toast, sometimes we cry a little. We’ve got people who’ve been here over a decade—and trust me, they’re not just here for the snacks.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.8: Because building a winning mentality isn’t just about pushing for the best. It’s about investing in people, growing together, and honouring those who’ve stayed by our side.

list.lisa.culture.mentality.completion: Still here? Thought so. Wanna head back to the culture menu, or return home and act like this never happened?
